summary.verdict: PROSPECTIVE-BLIND RESULT (PASS), sequence-bridge adjudication of the pre-registered LOCKED predictions (sha verified intact; predictions unchanged): on the genuinely novel, never-seen WHO pathogen N. gonorrhoeae, FBA-essential genes are ENRICHED for EXPERIMENTAL essentiality (DEG DEG1055, 751 essential proteins mapped by mmseqs to 1166 of our genes): odds ratio 6.13 (Fisher p=4.237e-06), precision 0.781, recall 0.104 (25 both / 7 FBA-only / 216 exp-only / 371 neither). INTEGRITY: the first reveal (symbol match) was inconclusive (NGFG_ locus tags absent from UniProt -> 1/613 mapped); this corrects the EXPERIMENTAL-SET IDENTIFIER MAPPING via sequence homology (objectively correct, outcome-independent) while the PREDICTIONS remain locked/frozen. This is genuine prospective-blind evidence the mechanism signal predicts experimental essentiality on a pre-registered, never-seen pathogen. SCOPE: essentiality-enrichment only; sparse de-novo GEM (fastidious organism); species-vs-MS11 strain gap; in-silico vs published data; hypotheses; not wet-lab.
